posts.author: CalebSol
posts.text:
Prediction markets are one of crypto’s most interesting sectors right now, and I like how @fortuneglobal_ is approaching them.

Fortune Agent is what stood out to me most. It’s more than a chatbot summarizing headlines. Its multi-agent system scans live news, sentiment and possible arbitrage opportunities, then validates potential trades based on the user’s chosen amount and risk level.

What I like is how it brings research and execution together. Instead of jumping between news feeds, market data and trading platforms, users can find opportunities and act on them from one place while keeping control of their risk.

Fortune also isn’t building another isolated prediction market. Its aggregator now brings Polymarket liquidity alongside Predictfun, letting users browse more markets and compare liquidity, volume and probabilities through one interface.

The updated flow also allows users to select an outcome, preview their position before trading and track open or settled positions in one portfolio.

Following its completed Pre-A round, Fortune is heading toward its TGE coming soon. Users can earn F-Points beforehand through prediction trading, daily activities and Council participation.

With its AI Agent, growing liquidity and rewards for active users, Fortune is looking strong heading into TGE!
